# Offer Card

`promotional/offer-card` &middot; section-level &middot; category: promotional

## Purpose

A bordered card presenting one offer: badge, title, description, discount, code and a button.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | text |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `badge` | text |  |
| `discount` | text |  |
| `description` | text |  |
| `code` | text |  |
| `expires` | text |  |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Card on the surface color with the theme border.
- **tinted**: Card on the page background color. Sets `background: @colors.background`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `align` | alignment | `"center"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `textColor` | text | `"@colors.text"` |
| `discountColor` | text | `"@colors.accent"` |
| `buttonBackground` | color | `"@colors.primary"` |
| `buttonColor` | color | `"@colors.primaryText"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@spacing.lg"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Background, border and padding honored. Rounded corners are square. | Fine. | Card background and text swap via dm-* classes on the brand surface. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('promotional/offer-card', {
  "badge": "Members only",
  "title": "A thank-you for being a regular",
  "discount": "$20 off",
  "description": "On your next order of $100 or more. No need to wait for a sale.",
  "code": "THANKS20",
  "expires": "Valid until 31 July",
  "cta": {
    "label": "Redeem my offer",
    "href": "https://example.com/discount/THANKS20"
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "promotional/offer-card",
  "data": {
    "badge": "Members only",
    "title": "A thank-you for being a regular",
    "discount": "$20 off",
    "description": "On your next order of $100 or more. No need to wait for a sale.",
    "code": "THANKS20",
    "expires": "Valid until 31 July",
    "cta": {
      "label": "Redeem my offer",
      "href": "https://example.com/discount/THANKS20"
    }
  }
}
```
